responsibility: This pipeline description models the Graywolf NDS32 core family for GCC scheduling. It defines a richer multi-pipeline automaton with separate integer and FPU resources, reservation tables for baseline, DSP, memory, and floating-point instruction classes, and bypass rules for address-output, load/memory, multiword memory, and FPU dependencies, providing the microarchitectural timing model used when -mcpu selects Graywolf-class processors.
